items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: Now, here, this fellow, Rudy, bless, had quite a lot of good ideas.

ctx.x: He interviewed someone in New York.

Well, I noticed he interviewed different musicians who talked. Well, he's never interviewed me, and I don't guess he stopped in Detroit. No, no. But he, La Cana, he talked to La Cana, and Johnny Stein. Now, Johnny Stein was another drummer, he was a drummer in New Orleans. Yeah. He was looked up to as quite a good drummer in those olden days. And, uh, there was another drummer by the name of Stevenson. Not Ragbabel Stevenson, but another Stevenson. I can't think of his first name as quite a fine drummer, too. Uh,…
Is that Ullunoff? Who is that? Ullunoff?
